study.question: At zero-based training calls512/8192, do original role-aggregation repeat differences or a fixed-tree replacement alter actual Adam moments or represented parameter updates in the inherited magnitude intervention, after no-op, sensitivity and exact-live-step checks? Latest schema4 candidate-owned probes at calls0/1 report role differences around7.8e-7 relative and tiny active gradient differences, but zero parameter-update distances and passing live bridges. r0025 M AUC0.6148622696747033 and Logloss0.1965286548016638 versus N0.6151021885074872 and0.19653258393542125: AUC loses while loss improves slightly. Prior historical M maximum0.6152795936767026 has not reproduced. We diagnose this consequential uncertainty instead of choosing another architecture or treating one early null as training-wide equality.
study.hypothesis: Later accumulated Adam state can retain role-induced rounding changes in first/second moments and possibly in represented parameter updates under total_magnitude, while the none path remains dormant. The alternative is that later differences remain ineffective at optimizer precision, or any observed discrepancy originates from other backward/scheduling effects. A moment difference alone supports moment propagation only. This experiment cannot establish a cause of final AUC drift or a full-run numerical repair.

Five actual-gradient branches each step a separate standard Adam clone using actual group flags and full pre-step table state; a sixth cloned-gradient perturbation at[row1,col0] of each table, g+=sign_nonzero(g)*(1e-3+16*abs(g)), checks measured response without touching live training. predictions: If aggregation has effective later optimizer propagation, at a valid M probe original-repeat or fixed-original gradient differences coincide with nonzero represented moment and/or update distances. Original-repeat is the strongest local repeatability contrast; fixed-original additionally changes association. Either nonzero parameter-update maximum is local evidence only.

N should show dormant gradient/moment/update differences of zero even if inactive role sums vary. Fixed-tree repeated gradients/full Adam outputs should agree exactly within each run. No-op gradients and complete Adam outputs should agree exactly.

The predeclared clone perturbation should produce strictly positive minimum per-table gradient, first moment, second moment and represented-update maxima, and the exact live parameter/full-state/gradient bridge should pass. If any fails, valid_probe=0; no automatic sensitivity retries or relaxed tolerances.

With valid probes, moment differences accompanied by zero update distances indicate represented moment propagation without measured parameter-update propagation. Zeros in both moments and updates remain scoped nulls at512/8192, not whole-run equality or proof of a rounding mechanism.

No directional AUC improvement is predicted. Record full-population validation AUC, unweighted Logloss, existing slices/counts, parameter counts, wall/train/memory/throughput/latency for both jobs, including adverse results. No unseen/missing-field slice or bootstrap is invented.
